name: INUKO
fix_description: In LpToSig, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a long multi-contract attack chain with 8 nested DODO flash loans, Venus lending/collateral manipulation, LP/bond-specific logic, and time-dependent claiming, which requires substantial protocol-specific understanding. Even if the core issue is bond pricing/accounting misuse, reproducing the exploit and determining the exact sequence would likely take an experienced auditor well over 2 hours.
